title.narrative: Water Access for Low-Income Urban Areas in Ghana 2025-2028

description.narrative: ?The embassy in Accra Ghana need to engage a consultant to assist with the last part of the formulation of the project related to access to water titled “Water Access for Low-Income Urban Areas in Ghana 2025-2028". The project will be formulated in close cooperation with UNICEF Ghana (implementing partner), Ghana Water Limited and the Ministry of Water and Sanitation (national counterpart). ???Based on the appraisal report, the consultant will address the major findings and recommendations, incorporating necessary design improvements, adjustments and follow-ups in close collaboration with the donor and the implementing partners and make a final proofread project document to be ready for submission to the Council for Development Policy (UPR).?????????
